report: Reviewed the complete field_prose claim, parser implementation, both associated test bodies, and captured parse_body setup. Named fields accept optional triple-quoted text immediately before their name: tokenization retains text, value_fields calls optional_prose then word and stores description on each ValueField. Struct declaration and named variant parsing consume container prose first, so a second consecutive string belongs to the first field. Later field prose is consumed independently on subsequent iterations. parses_structs_enums_and_opaque_generics asserts distinct Pair container and first-field descriptions and successfully parses fields without prose; named_variant_fields_keep_their_own_prose asserts distinct variant, first-field, and second-field descriptions. These assertions would detect conflating container/field text or carrying prior field text into the next field. All one implementation and two test entries are ordinary; no TODO/N/A prerequisites or deferred claims exist. Independently verified exact byte equality of current parser.rs, language.rs, and value_types.rs with historical snapshots after joining snapshot lines with newline; the historical rationale remains sufficient against current inputs. This is source assessment, not personal test execution. Personally ran review start/read and byte comparison; coordinator separately reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and cargo build passing. No source modifications or additional behavioral test runs were needed.
